definitions.explanation: Belief in one's own abilities, qualities, or judgment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自信|じしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちている→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}して→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧{自信|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた。
examples.english: I gained confidence after passing the exam.

notes:
{自信|じしん} refers to confidence in oneself and one's abilities.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {自信|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have confidence
- {自信|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to lack confidence
- {自信|じしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have confidence
- {自信|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: to gain confidence
- {自信|じしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose confidence
- {自信|じしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: full of confidence
- {自信|じしん}⟦{過剰|かじょう}→過剰：04123_kajou⟧: overconfidence

- ⟦{確信|かくしん}→確信：13682_kakushin⟧: conviction, firm belief (about something external)
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧: trust (in others)
